opsec.actionWipe: Panic: local wipe then apparent crash
opsec.duressNote: If this PIN is entered on the lock screen, the configured OpSec action runs instead of the normal unlock.
opsec.requiresLock: Enable the Lock Screen first: the Duress Password only triggers from the PIN entry screen.
opsec.requiresUnlockedLock: Unlock and enable the Lock Screen before saving a Duress PIN.
opsec.hideLockIdentity: Hide username and avatar on the Lock Screen
opsec.hideLockIdentityNote: Recommended: keeps the multi-user Lock Screen plausible without revealing which account is protected.
opsec.decoyConfigured: A decoy profile is configured on this device.
opsec.decoyNote: Configuration logs you out temporarily and opens onboarding. Register or log in to a separate decoy account, customize it, then refresh the app to return to the real lock screen.
opsec.decoySetupConfirm: This will temporarily log you out and open onboarding so you can configure the decoy profile. After creating or logging in to the decoy account, refresh the app to return to the real lock screen. Continue?
opsec.ramOnlyNote: When enabled, QxChat stops writing to LocalStorage/IndexedDB and clears existing local persistence. Data disappears after close or reload.

notifications.messageSound: Play a sound for new messages

notifications.localOnlyNote: Notifications are created on this device. No Google or Apple push service is used and nothing passes through a third party; QxChat must stay open in the background to receive them.

calls.turnInvalid: Invalid address. Use turn:, turns: or stun:

turnHints.qxp-turn: Self-hosted relay on our infrastructure, may be unstable under load. No IP exposed, everything goes through our relay.
turnHints.google-stun: Google public STUN, very stable and fast, but ⚠️ your IPs are exposed (no anonymous relay). Only useful on local networks or for testing.

calls.micGateIdle: Start the test to watch your level against the threshold.
calls.micGateClosed: Under the threshold, so nothing is sent.
calls.cameraPreviewHint: Nothing leaves this machine. The preview runs locally.

tor.title: Tor connectivity
tor.enabledNote: Route the app's traffic through the Tor network. First boot can take several seconds while Tor downloads its consensus.
tor.restartNote: Changing this setting will restart QxChat completely.
tor.trayNote: Tor is managed from the system tray. Right-click the QxChat tray icon and toggle “Connect through Tor”, the app will restart to apply the change.
tor.externalNote: A foreign Tor is already using the port. Traffic is routed through it, but the live circuit view is unavailable.
tor.notRunning: Start Tor before loading the relay directory.
tor.circuitNote: The path your traffic takes through the Tor network (guard → middle → exit).
tor.relaysNote: Live relays from the official Tor Metrics directory, sorted by consensus weight.
tor.relaysDesktopOnly: This experience is only available on Desktop Client.
tor.relaysConfirm: This will fetch the live relay directory from Onionoo (onionoo.torproject.org). If you are in a strategically sensitive environment, this is probably not recommended.
tor.desktopOnly: Tor routing is only available in the QxChat desktop app, which embeds the Tor client and routes your traffic locally. On the web version, your connection depends on your browser and cannot be routed through Tor.

advanced.serverClears: Let the server clear local message cache
advanced.serverClearsNote: Enabled by default. When disabled, reconnecting keeps Android/browser cached room messages even if the server history is empty after a protocol refresh.
advanced.serverDefaultRoom: Let the server make you join the default room
advanced.autoArchive: Automatically archive files in .zip when upload
advanced.autoArchiveNote: Disabled by default. When enabled, uploaded attachments are wrapped in a ZIP file before sending. Upload limit: 25 MB.
advanced.renameUploadsNote: When enabled, uploaded files are renamed to a random 8-character a-z/0-9 token (the extension is kept).
advanced.stripExifNote: When enabled, image metadata (GPS, camera, timestamps) is removed locally before sending (JPEG EXIF and PNG eXIf chunks) without re-encoding the image.

discordRpc.title: Discord Rich Presence
discordRpc.enabledNote: Enabled by default. Shows “Playing QxChat” with the QxChat icon on your Discord profile (desktop client only).
discordRpc.showPlatformNote: Shows a small auto-detected Windows, macOS or Linux icon next to the activity.
discordRpc.disconnected: Not connected to Discord (open Discord to enable presence).
discordRpc.unavailable: Discord Rich Presence is unavailable on this platform.

admin.title: Admin
admin.defaultRoomNote: Pick a room you already belong to. Its E2EE key goes to the server, which hands it to everyone on connect. That is accepted by design for a public news channel.
admin.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete account {username} from the database and network?
admin.searchUsersNote: Enter a username to display a user's details.
admin.snapshotNote: Connections count sessions, so one account can appear several times. Room and message figures come from the server's in-memory buffer, not from a historical total.
admin.noSnapshot: No snapshot loaded. Use Refresh to try again.
admin.selfNote: You cannot delete your own account from here.
admin.badgesNote: Badges are decoration only and grant no permission. Badges the server assigns itself cannot be edited here.
admin.disableConfirm: Disable {username}? Their sessions are closed immediately.
admin.banConfirm: Ban {username}? Their sessions are closed immediately.
admin.defaultRoomClearConfirm: Clear the default room? New members will no longer join it automatically.
admin.defaultRoomNoOptions: No room you hold a key for. Open one of your rooms first so its key can be shared.
admin.badgeLimit: This account has reached the badge limit. Remove one to add another.
admin.roomsShown: Showing {shown} of {total} rooms. Use the filter to narrow the list.
admin.badgeShadowed: The server already grants this same badge, so this one never shows. Click to remove it.
admin.roomsLegend: Each row shows people online, then messages held in memory.
admin.chartSignupsNote: The last 30 days, counted from the accounts that exist now, so deleted ones are not in it.
admin.chartMessagesNote: Currently held in memory; the server keeps no history.
admin.statMessagesNote: The server buffers messages and keeps no history, so these are current figures, not a record over time.
admin.chartActivityNote: How recently each room last saw traffic.
admin.chartAccountAgeNote: Derived from the 24 hour and 7 day counts the server reports.
admin.chartLastMessage: Rooms by day of last message
admin.chartLastMessageNote: Counts the rooms whose most recent buffered message falls on each day.
admin.chartPlatformsNote: Share of the live sessions, by client.
admin.chartAccountStateNote: Every account the server holds, split by state.
admin.statConnectionsNote: More sessions than accounts means people are signed in from more than one place.
admin.chartOnlineNote: Distinct accounts connected, against every account the server holds.
admin.statRuntimeNote: Counters held in memory only. Nothing is written down and they reset when the server restarts.

backups.title: Backups
backups.note: Backups include username, room list, history metadata, reactions, and unread counters. Attachment data is excluded.
backups.clearConfirm: Clear all local data? This removes all conversations, messages, and reactions from this browser. The remote server is not affected.

donation.title: Donate
donation.subtitle: QxChat is free and open source. Support development by sending crypto to one of the addresses below.
donation.note: Donations are received directly to the listed wallets. Always double-check the network before sending.

about.title: About
about.contributorsConfirm: This will call the GitHub API (api.github.com). If you are in a strategically sensitive environment, this is probably not recommended.
about.badgesConfirm: This will load license badges from img.shields.io, which queries GitHub. If you are in a strategically sensitive environment, this is probably not recommended.
about.quote:
Our work is purely and entirely free, libre, and open source. We stand for a free world where communications between members are truly anonymized, private, and encrypted.
QxChat is the world we want to build.
about.integrityNote: Compare these fingerprints with the ones published for this version. If they differ, this copy of the app has been modified.

phantom.title: Friends
phantom.selfRequest: You can't add yourself as a friend.
phantom.usernameWarning: The server will know you searched for this username.
phantom.recoveryNeeded: Re-enter your recovery words (Settings → Security) to load your friends.
phantom.pollIntervalHint: Between 3 and 40 seconds. Leave empty for automatic (15-30 s).
phantom.pollUniformityNote: Caution: the protocol relies on a uniform polling cadence to guarantee anonymity. Changing this interval breaks the default fingerprint (constant polling at the normative value) and makes your client more identifiable.
phantom.pollingNote: Polling is off: the friend system is paused and new requests or updates will not be received.

crop.invalidImage: Please choose a valid image file.
crop.animatedKept: Animated image kept as is: cropping would freeze it on its first frame.

dialog.clearDataConfirm: Clear all local data? Every conversation, message and reaction is removed from this device. Nothing on the server is touched.

recoveryNotice.title: Keep your recovery words safe
recoveryNotice.titleRecover: Your recovery words were saved again
recoveryNotice.lead: This file was just saved to your Downloads folder. It holds the 12 words that give access to your account.
recoveryNotice.onlyWayTitle: The only way back into your account
recoveryNotice.onlyWay: If you forget your password, these words are all that can recover it. Nobody, not even QxChat, can reset them.
recoveryNotice.offline: On paper or in a password manager, then delete the file from your Downloads.
recoveryNotice.neverShare: Anyone with these words can take over your account. QxChat will never ask for them.
recoveryNotice.confirm: I have stored my recovery words somewhere safe
recoveryNotice.verifyLead: Type the words asked below to confirm you copied them correctly.
recoveryNotice.wrong: One of the words does not match.
recoveryNotice.doneLead: Your recovery words are safely stored. Keep them away from your devices.

lock.title: Lock the app
lock.body: Protect QxChat with a PIN that encrypts your local data, with automatic locking after a delay.

duress.title: Duress code
duress.body: A second PIN that, entered under pressure, wipes your data or opens a harmless decoy account.

ramOnly.title: RAM-only mode
ramOnly.body: Nothing is written to this device: everything disappears when the app closes.

poll.label: Poll
poll.question: Question
poll.visibilityNote: Encrypted end to end. Votes are anonymous and final, and results appear once you have voted.
poll.alreadyVoted: You already voted in this poll.
